news.title: Call recorder? TrollRecorder is TrollStore-only
news.caption: TrollRecorder (Lessica) is the only open-source iOS call recorder on GitHub, but it requires TrollStore (iOS 15-17, CoreTrust). It can NOT install via Sidestore/AltStore — Apple blocks call recording in the sandbox. We removed it from this Sidestore source; TrollStore users can install TRApp_4.5-3632.tipa directly from https://github.com/Lessica/TrollRecorder/releases/tag/v4.5-3632. No Sidestore-compatible call recorder exists.

news.title: Welcome to Kevin's Legit Source
news.caption: 24 apps — open-source classics, SwiftUI value apps, vetted tweaked patchers and AppDB. Every IPA links straight to its upstream GitHub Release — no repacks. If an app vanishes, check its linked tag for a newer IPA.

news.title: How to add this source to Sidestore
news.caption: Sidestore: Settings > Sources > Add Source > paste https://kb01111.github.io/Sideload-Sources/source.json . AltStore: Sources > + > same URL. Or tap at https://kb01111.github.io/Sideload-Sources/ on your iPhone.

news.title: Why these 24? Criteria
news.caption: All 24 have a tagged GitHub Release with a .ipa asset. Core = OSI + no piracy. Value = SwiftUI / patcher / AppDB where the IPA is the project's official artifact. Excluded: uYou+/Enhanced, YTLitePlus, EeveeSpotify (451) — no Release IPA.
